tei:div.tei:p: "$ (67)༄༅// 'jam mgon bla ma gu ṇa'i mtshan gyi skyes rabs gsol 'debs lha yi rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ rigs rnams kun bdag rnam par snang mdzad dang*// rdo rje chos dang yul 'khor skyong ba'i sras// tha chung gzhon nu blo gros mtha' yas la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// kun dga' bo dang chos rgyal zla ba bzang*// rgyal po dza dang ār+ya dā+e ba'i zhabs// shan+tiṃ gar+bha zla grags nag po par// gsol ba= 'jam dbyangs sprul pa thon mi sam+bho ṭa// dge slong pūr+ṇa lo chen bai ro'i zhabs// tshul khrims shes rab ye shes 'byung gnas la// gsol ba= dbang phyug 'bar dang zur chen shākya 'byung*// rong zom chos bzang khyung po rnal 'byor dang*// blo ldan shes rab bon po lha 'bum la// gsol ba= gu ru jo rtse ra shag gter ston dang*// grub thob dngos grub nyi ma seṅge dang*// ye shes khyung grags 'gro mgon skye med zhang*// gsol ba= sa skya paṇa chen sgom sde sangs rgyas 'bum// bla ma gnyen ras g.yag sde paṇa chen dang*// rdo rje gling pa brag thog bsod nams bzang*// gsol ba= 'gos lo gzhon nu kun mkhyen bo dong pa// rig pa'i ral gri pad+ma kun skyong gling*// mchog ldan mgon po blo gros thogs med la// gsol ba= nam mkha' rin chen shes rab 'od zer dang*// sgrol ba'i mgon po rig 'dzin chos go cha// sna tshogs rang grol o rgyan gter bdag gling*// gsol ba= bde chen gling pa kun gzigs bla ma mchog /yon tan ji snyed chu klung kun 'dus pa'i// chos kyi rgya mtsho chen po gang de la// gsol ba= slar yang rgyal ba'i bstan dang gdul bya'i don// phrin las bsam mi khyab pa'i rol pa yis// skye ba sprul sku'i ngo mtshar du ma'i mthar// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa yi// tha mar gyur pa mos pa snang mdzad ces// sangs rgyas (68)stong gi sku tshe phrin las kun// gcig bsdus nyid du mngon par sangs rgyas la// gsol ba= de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// skye ba 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// mgon mchog dam pa rnams kyis rjes bzung nas// thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mngon byed shog

/ces 'jam mgon bla ma yon tan rgya mtsho rin po che'i skyes rabs gsol 'debs shig bris zhes kun gzigs bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bka' stsal pheb pa dang*/ gzhan yang blo gsal karma rin chen dar rgyas sogs mos ldan 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba las// 'jam mgon bla ma 'di nyid lo chen bai ro tsa na'i rnam 'phrul du o rgyan rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bstan pa dang*/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po smin gling 'gyur med rdo rje'i skye sprul du nges pa rnyed pa bcas de dag gi skyes rabs kyi phreng ba dang mthun par gsol 'debs 'di bzhin/ dpal karma pa'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba bcu bzhi pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi byin rlabs tsam thob pa/ dpal ldan theg pa mchog gi rdo rjes dpal spung thub bstan chos 'khor gling gan+dho la'i yang rtse rje btsun sgrol ma dgyes pa'i bsti gnas su bris pa dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
